description: Hypothesis: replace the legacy draft context FC and N=32/N=1 target prefill projections with FP16-operand TensorOps paths with packed-input reuse to reduce wall time. Draft FC newly rounds activations to FP16; weights remain the same BF16 checkpoint, with FP32 accumulation and output. Small projections retain FP16 operands; compute the scalar gate before shared-expert down to reuse Norm input. The SIMD scalar prototype was rejected after a real-model logit comparison. Preserve affine-8 group-64 v2 target weights, FP16 KV, FP32 recurrent state, GDN preparation, DFlash2, complete draft context capture, prefix checkpoints, 2048-token chunks and 32768-token context. Run all seven Full-profile tests.
